customer_updates.name: Rosy Kohli
customer_updates.text:
I have been shopping at Tirumala Shopping Center for more than 25 years, and it has always been my most trusted place.
Earlier, it was just a one-floor shop, but now it has expanded into a huge shopping center with separate sections for sarees, dress materials, ready-made outfits, and unstitched collections. This makes shopping very easy and well-organized.
One memorable experience — my cousin sister lives in Canada. Once my Jijaji came to India and wanted to gift her a saree. I asked him to come at 11 AM, and within one hour we selected a beautiful saree. They immediately did fall & pico, added tassels, and arranged a ready-made blouse. By evening, everything was delivered to his address.
When he asked about international delivery, they confirmed they deliver globally, which is very helpful.
In my family also, for weddings, we go around 11 AM and by 4 PM our complete shopping is done — sarees, dress materials, ghagra choli, everything under one roof.
My suggestion: don’t waste time checking too many options. Just tell your budget and preference — they have everything from simple to heavy designs.
Personally, I prefer light embroidery, and I always find elegant options here.
Highly recommended for quick, hassle-free wedding shopping in one day!
Parking 🅿️ is available.
You can see from Road shopping centre.
Landmark DN Nagar Metro station.
The entrance is accessible ♿
But inside few steps are there with steel handle to hold & climb.

featured_reviews.name: STORYCIRCLE EduSaarthi By Yogita Ahuja
featured_reviews.review_text:
I ordered a Frog scooty from Green bell and inspite of paying almost 500/- additional as the courier delivery charge..the scooty came broken as it wasn't packed properly  and with no box or manual inside.. when I tried to contact Green bell people..they would not pick up the phone and no response to my messages...No one listens and no one speaks...Bad Customer service..Pathetic infact

To your response...
No one spoke to me...How many times I picked up their call and then called them back multiple times as well and no one picked up or even responded to my messages ...before I put this review up today
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Greetings Mrs. Ahuja,

We would firstly like to truly apologise for the experience you faced in our store and would like to thank you for bringing this to our notice as this is not the kind of experience we wish to give anyone, let alone our customers.

We have noted down this complaint and our team shall begin following up on this as we would like to this opportunity to ensure this does not repeat henceforth with you or any of our customers since we truly care. We have also noticed that our team attempted to connect with you multiple times but haven’t been able to due to no response. Kindly grant us 24hours and the team shall get in touch with you for further investigation as we would happily wish to ensure that you are given a proper resolution for the same.

We truly apologise for this experience and we will try our best to fix it to the best of our possibility!

Warm Regards

featured_reviews.review_text: As always, over the years, you guys have been super in your product options and service. So polite, prompt and helpful. It's been over 15 years I've been coming here. From my own school days up to now for my baby... you'll have everything.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you Mrs. Oshtori for your kind words! We appreciate you taking a moment out to convey this appreciation, it’s these words that keep us motivated and consistently keep us hustling to get the ease of shopping to you!

featured_reviews.name: viswash sadhu06
featured_reviews.review_text:
"I recently had the pleasure of visiting Green Bell and was thoroughly impressed! The salesman was exceptionally knowledgeable and helpful, taking the time to answer all my questions and offering expert recommendations for my baby's needs. The store was immaculately organized, clean, and boasted an extensive range of high-quality products at competitive prices.

What truly set my experience apart, however, was the salesman's outstanding customer service. He went above and beyond to ensure I found everything I needed, even offering to carry my purchases to the car. His friendly demeanor and dedication to ensuring a positive shopping experience made my visit truly enjoyable. I highly recommend Green Bell to anyone seeking exceptional service and top-notch products!"
